 ORDER Called again in the afternoon.
2.
The learned counsel for the appellants has again remained absent.

3. A perusal of the order sheet would go to show that inspite of granting several and sufficient opportunities of not less than eight times, the learned counsel for the appellants has not complied the office objections.

On 04.01.2024, this Court had made the following observation:
"Even in the afternoon session, none appears.

Though six adjournments have been granted for compliance of office objections,
office objections are not complied with.
The appeal deserves to be dismissed for non- compliance of office objections.

However, in the interest of justice, one more Giddegowda vs Narayanaswamy on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156940198/
2 opportunity is granted to the appellants to comply with the office objections subject to appellants paying cost of Rs.500/- in the Legal Services Committee, High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru within a week.

sentences.text: 5. Inspite of above, according to the Registry, learned counsel for the appellants has not filed any memo along with receipt showing the payment of the cost as ordered above.
Further, the office objections have remained not complied.
Under the above circumstances, it has to be inferred that the appellants are not interested in prosecuting the appeal which is of the year 2023.
As such, the appeal stands dismissed for non-compliance of office objections as well as for non-prosecution.
